_readme: MONEY-1359 — ANY fatal or critical line, anywhere, in one environment.
No service placeholder and no threshold to tune: the claim is that a single
one of these is worth interrupting someone for, in any service. A per-service
copy would be four monitors that each need a floor, and a floor above zero on
a fatal is a statement nobody would defend out loud.
15 minutes rather than an hour, because unlike error volume this is not a
rate — the first one is the whole signal and the delay to notice is the only
name: [{{env}}] a FATAL log line
